title: Charts and Lenses - stock interior, NEUTRAL B (SNES register)
_note: Stock interior cue for thoughtful, curious rooms: workshops, studies, a watcher's cottage full of star-charts (first use: Nightreach's Watcher's Cottage). No Vesper motif - a self-contained inquisitive tune. A Dorian (the raised 6th F# = the bright D-major IV: curiosity, not sorrow), 96 BPM 4/4, 24 bars A-B-A'. pulse25 lead asks questions (phrases end up on E/F#); tri_bass walks like clockwork; a PLUCK marimba ostinato in steady eighths; dry woodblock-clock ticks (hat) on every beat; 3rd+7th STRINGS shells; a BELL music-box glint at phrase ends; a TRIANGLE bassoon-like counter-line answers the lead through B and A'. snes era (small-room reverb). Last bar (Em, B) steps down into the A that opens bar 1.
